upstream_preparation_check: Current upstream checked during preparation, unchanged. Existing verified native build is reused; no moving-ref checks at build or launch.

gow.visual_80s: Kratos in snowy forest; missing/black regions, overlay 11 FPS / 94.4 ms.
gow.visual_110s: Black except overlay 10 FPS / 104.4 ms; not gameplay recovery.
gow.threads_110s: GPU renderer and WSI presentation threads wait in drm_syncobj_array_wait_timeout.constprop.0; audio threads show ordinary futex/timer sleeps.
gow.stop_state: Main leader zombie; SDLAudioP35 remains in D state at dma_fence_wait_any_timeout. Thread name alone does not establish an audio-mixing root cause.
gow.kernel_log_visibility: Both unprivileged captures deny system-journal visibility; no kernel-clean claim is possible.
gow.driver: RADV 25.0.7, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX NAVI31, physical subgroup size 64

got.reason: Batch stopped after GoW owned-process termination remained unconfirmed. No new GoT launch failure or native PR185 layout outcome is established.

performance.caution: Inclusive regions overlap and must not be summed. Whole-run counters and different scenes do not establish an FPS regression or improvement.
performance.wait_progress: First sustained interval near 90 seconds waits for tick 32210 with completed 32207. Later interval near 106 seconds waits for 32248 with completed 32245. Some progress occurs between long waits; these are not proof of a permanently stalled single shader.
performance.readback_bytes_caution: Image-readback counter records requested scan bytes; it is not measured physical GPU transfer traffic.

deep_research.head: 13b8acd0017e5a6ce80e22c0f0587a6fbfabb120
deep_research.finding: Adds guest stencil-plane uploads and dirty/alias propagation; current retained branch still excludes stencil from RefreshImage and links stencil proxies without that upload. Credible missing-fill lead.
deep_research.decision: Not integrated blindly. Need ownership, clean/reused R8 proxy, alias bounds and tiled S8 validation. No proof this is the GoT defect.

deep_research.head: 9f55474ad45778f8ac08e923574f214d492997f2
deep_research.finding: Moves normal Audio3d output to a per-port feeder; associated-port flush still drains on caller.
deep_research.decision: Captured renderer is waiting for GPU completion. This is not evidence that the feeder fixes this stall.

deep_research.head: 644c5bd686553442432d1fda211169ad69f28924
deep_research.finding: Lowers ordered count to buffer atomic add (with first-lane/add-lane variants). Source review does not find full guest wave ordering/control preservation.
deep_research.decision: Not a semantics-preserving universal replacement for the retained ordered continuation protocol; no benchmark claim.

deep_research.head: d780d5343aca3715657fd10e17811079ac27ca60
deep_research.finding: Audio deadline/pacing and duplicate wait changes have other-title evidence; not linked to this GPU completion failure.
deep_research.decision: Not selected as a hang fix.

deep_research.finding: Reviewed wave32-half synchronization/ballot leads against native subgroup64 and compute wave64 request. They do not directly establish the native failing path.
deep_research.decision: No indiscriminate wave32 fixes applied; graphics/individual shaders would still require evidence.

deep_research.finding: Reuse of unchanged small buffers is a plausible CPU cost optimization. Current retained path still streams small reads.
deep_research.decision: Needs coherence/invalidations audit and same-scene measurements; not established as the GPU stall cause.

deep_research.finding: Bounded timeline spin polling targets short host-wait latency, not evidence for the observed ten-second GPU stalls.
Pending image-transition merging overlaps already-retained serialization of pending transitions.
deep_research.decision: No unreviewed overlapping synchronization patch applied.

deep_research.finding: Later official Mesa releases contain GFX11/driver hang and shader correctness fixes. Native RADV is 25.0.7.
deep_research.decision: Driver is a credible separate lead, not a matched root cause. Read kernel reset/fault messages first; no host package or driver change made.

deep_research.finding: Retained ordered-count continuation path performs packet completion, checkpoint completion and GDS snapshot completion in nonterminal phases.
deep_research.decision: Batching those dependent readbacks may reduce host/GPU synchronization cost after equivalence validation. Not implemented; the measured inclusive cost contains GPU waits.

deep_research.finding: Other-emulator GoW PS5 progress and stencil alias fixes were examined as analogues.
deep_research.decision: Different emulator, guest build and ISA. No direct PS4 compatibility or patch portability claim.

capture_defects: PerformanceDiagnostics::Enabled disables both Record and Dump in the GPU history recorder. The latest gpu-work.log is empty for that reason.
Unprivileged journal commands cannot see kernel messages on this host; empty output does not establish healthy GPU state.
changes: Explicit trace mode enables existing GPU command history with shader dumps, disables Vulkan validation/host markers and uses asynchronous logging.
Trace overrides inherited performance mode; direct conflicting trace+performance or trace+validation use is rejected.
Explicit opt-in bounded sudo -n journalctl captures before any game and after launched runs; password authentication occurs once in the user paste, not inside the runner.
GoT first in the immutable existing-build handoff. No C++ or guest-emulation changes and no native rebuild.

validation.syntax: Bash syntax, Python compilation and git diff --check pass.
validation.production_gpu_history: Production C++ header compiled with GCC14; trace emits only the matching semaphore and incomplete requested tick, suppresses duplicate output, and performance=1 reproduces absent history.
validation.handoff: Pinned existing-build handoff, bad checksum, download failure and failed sudo authentication checked using substituted commands; no games or privileged operations run on the analysis host.
validation.emulator_build: Unchanged source passed user native full build and CPU/startup checks. GPU acceptance failed, not promoted.

limitations: No measured FPS improvement, cutscene recovery, GoT fill recovery, audio fix or VUID clearance.

Command ring is bounded and may overwrite earlier work; ordered-GDS continuation dispatches do not themselves have a shader-labelled RecordWork entry, though surrounding commands/resources remain available.
Shader dumping and command history add overhead; this trace is not an FPS benchmark.
An existing uninterruptible GPU thread may prevent launch. Preflight then captures evidence and stops without restart, broad kill, or Sunshine/SSH action.
Unreadable root journal or expired sudo credentials are recorded, not converted to a clean kernel result.
protections: 120 seconds per game; owned-process shutdown; no automated input; screenshots/FPS; at least 8 GiB free VRAM; unload and conditionally restore exact model lease; no installed binary replacement.
